column1: # What every creature in the captures looks like, from Tools/Capture/WorldMobs.
# Do not edit by hand - re-run the tool.
# monster is SimpleCharFullUpdate.MonsterData, the body. One body carries several
# names, so the name is the key here and the body is not.
# healthScale is what maximum health is a multiple of - see MissionCreature.Health,
# which holds the ramp it multiplies. That ramp was measured over levels 19 to 44
# only, so the scale is written for creatures seen inside it and left at zero for
# the rest rather than fitted where it would mean nothing.
# health is every level and maximum health this creature was actually seen with,
# as level:health. That is the measurement; the scale is a summary of it.
